verdict.rationale: Warp ships two official CLIs, both richly documented. The Oz CLI runs and manages cloud agents from any terminal, script or CI pipeline, with API-key auth, agent profiles, MCP connections and Warp Drive references. The standalone Warp Agent CLI (`warp` command) works in any terminal emulator, over SSH, or where the app isn't installed. A probe confirms the CLI reference docs exist. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of either CLI (the only community mention, comm-18, is a vague nod to 'good CLI integration').
